description: Both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md state 'the 9 enduring principles' when referencing the constitution. Principle X (Pedantic Linting & Formatting) was added in constitution v3.1.0 (ratified 2026-05-12), bringing the total to 10. The constitution's own Sync Impact Report notes 'Templates requiring updates' for CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md but those updates were never applied.
title: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md claim 9 principles; constitution has 10
code_does: .specify/memory/constitution.md contains 10 principles (I through X). Principle X 'Pedantic Linting & Formatting' was added in v3.1.0.
documentation_says: CLAUDE.md line 9: '9 enduring principles. Read before non-trivial work.' AGENTS.md line 8: 'the 9 enduring principles.'

description: README.md references '17 specs total' in two places: the project structure tree comment and the development commands table. The actual test suite has 26 .spec.js files. Features 006 and 007 added specs (timer-abort, timer-complete, timer-distraction, timer-distraction-multi, timer-overtime, timer-quick-log, timer-quick-log-break, inventory, visual-regression-overtime) but the README was not updated.
title: README.md spec count is stale: claims 17, actual is 26
documentation_says: README.md line 173 (project tree): '*.spec.js  # 17 specs total (one per screen / major flow)'. README.md line 228 (commands table): 'Run the e2e suite (17 specs)'.

description: README.md documents the visual regression command as running '12 baselines'. The actual baseline directory contains 18 PNG files. New baselines were added for timer states (focus-continuous-overtime, focus-paused-with-complete) and additional screens without updating the README count.
title: README.md baseline count is stale: claims 12, actual is 18
documentation_says: README.md line 229 (commands table): 'Run the visual regression suite (12 baselines)'.

description: The e2e CLAUDE.md explicitly states 'Vite is used to serve src/ as a static HTTP server' and gives a rationale about MIME types and ES module resolution. This is false: the dev server is Trunk (a Rust/WASM build tool), configured via the webServer block in playwright.config.js with 'trunk serve --no-autoreload' from the src/ crate directory. The e2e CLAUDE.md appears to be a holdover from before the Leptos migration (feature 001) was completed.
title: tests/e2e/CLAUDE.md says Vite serves the frontend; playwright.config.js uses Trunk
code_does: tests/e2e/playwright.config.js webServer block: command: 'trunk serve --no-autoreload', cwd: '../../src'. Trunk is the build/serve tool for the Leptos WASM frontend, not Vite.
documentation_says: tests/e2e/CLAUDE.md (Dev-server choice section): 'Vite is used to serve src/ as a static HTTP server because src/index.html uses <script type="module"> imports, which require a server that sets correct text/javascript MIME types and supports ES module resolution.'
